How it works

Start in under a minute

  1. Scan your cardThe el be card from your HCA physiotherapist. Scan it with your phone camera.
  2. Create your accountSign up with your email address.
  3. Enter your codeThe code on your card unlocks two months of free access to the el be app.
  4. Your class is waitingFind a class or programme that suits you, on your phone, tablet or TV.

A note from Louise

Hello, and welcome

I created el be so that good Pilates, taught by professional teachers, could fit into everyday life, for men and women at every age and stage.

Your physiotherapist knows you best, so follow their advice and take it at your own pace. Some weeks you will do a little, some weeks more. If you miss a day, that is fine. It will be there when you are ready.

The app is a real community. Ask anything, and a professional Pilates instructor will be there to answer. We are so glad you are here.

Louise x
